name: designs-crm
description: Designs CRM monorepo (Vite React SPA + NestJS + MySQL, no ORM)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run -w @designs-crm/api build && npm run -w @designs-crm/web build
scripts.lint: npm run -w @designs-crm/api lint && npm run -w @designs-crm/web lint
